paragraphs: R. Teraya: Chazit Midrash, on “Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved,” and again there on the second occurrence of that verse. But Bereshit Rabbah, section 33, has that matter in R. Bivi's name, and Vayikra Rabbah, section 31, in R. Berekhiah's name.
